class.description: DOD NOTE: GameOptionsMenu acts as a headless-capable, slot-injected View-Binder and transactional staging controller over the `GameplayStyle` / `GameplayMode` cascade. Rather than hardcoding a monolithic UI tree or mutating live resources directly on every slider tick, GameOptionsMenu: 1. Resolves its target context (`target_entity` such as a `GameBoard` or `GameAgent`, or the root `Game`, or an explicit `GameplayStyle` / `GameplayMode`). 2. Snapshots a baseline backup and creates a deep staging clone (`_staged_mode`) when opened, enabling optional real-time previewing (`live_preview_enabled`) while preserving zero-side-effect rollback on `cancel_options()`. 3. Supports both bespoke designer-injected UI hierarchies (via `@export` container and button slots) and automatic fallback UI generation (`auto_build_fallback_ui`) across all six gameplay domains: Graphics, Audio, Control Maps, Difficulty, Perspective, and Accessibility. 4. Enforces a 15-second display confirmation watchdog when resolution scale or window mode changes are applied, automatically reverting if unconfirmed. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
